Oh, you think so? Well, yes, it would have been nice to have more info on the AoL. It was not to be expected; if Jordan had wanted to give us any more info on the past Age, he would have already. I was glad to see the Forsaken go.

Elza and Delana hade made their choices. No Black sister receives my grace. And Jeaine Caide's death was awesome, Thom casually flipping a knife in her back. Hehe.

I will never understand what a strange perversion mr Jordan and mr Sanderson have for the Seanchan. Had I been allowed to direct the Last Battle, I would have used the Seanchan for cannon fodder, and made Fortuona an "unfortunate casualty of war", taking all the sul'dam with her. Oh, and Selucia.
